messages:
Mira - AE: Heads-up: CobaltHealth requested a 2-week POC to validate a customer-tuned 9B variant + embeddings. Requirements: streaming chat, embeddings index, SAML SSO, HIPAA scope, and target ~110ms p50 token latency. They9d like BYOK for keys.
Owen - Sales Eng: Do we have artifact details? quant/format/adapter?
Mira - AE: They said qint8 export with a LoRA adapter (safetensors) and tokenizer.json included. Also vendor supplied a short eval set.
Kai - ML Eng: qint8 + LoRA generally ok but we must run a compatibility sweep for KV cache layout and attention kernels. I'll kick off a scan.
Kai - ML Eng: Running: `ri-compat-scan --file cobalt_9b_qint8.tar.gz --tokenizer --kv --simulate-stream`
CapacityBot: Pool check OK: "poc-west-1" has 2x A100 + 1x T4 available for requested window.
Kai - ML Eng: Scan result: tokenizer loads, 6 OOV tokens -> will map. Model loads but one attention op uses legacy fused kernel -> needs small shim/adapter. Estimated eng work: 24-36h to land patch + 24h perf validation. Streaming p50 after fix ~95-120ms on A100 with tuned batching.
Owen - Sales Eng: Timeline risk flagged. For POC pricing can we do reserved + metered? They asked for estimate per 1M tokens and one reserved GPU for baseline tests.
Mira - AE: Suggested provisional: $4,200 reserved (2 weeks, includes one reserved GPU) + $0.70 per 1k tokens over allowance. Mark provisional until compatibility confirmed.
Lila - Security: HIPAA requires Dedicated/Private and signed BAA/DPA prior to any PHI. BYOK supported on Private; need KMS ARN and key policy. Also request SOC2 report and a network/dataflow diagram. I'll send the sec questionnaire now.
Mira - AE: I'll ask CobaltHealth to return signed DPA/BAA + KMS details in 3 business days to keep timeline.
Kai - ML Eng: Created INF-8512 for adapter shim, tokenizer mapping, and streaming regression tests. Will include perf vectors and sample queries from the customer. ETA patch 36h, validation 24h.
LegalBot: Reminder: Attach POC SOW and provisional DPA template. No data ingestion until docs signed.
Owen - Sales Eng: Action items: Mira to collect DPA/KMS, Lila to circulate security checklist, Kai to post INF-8512 updates, Owen to send provisional quote and schedule kickoff.
Mira - AE: Scheduling kickoff for next Tuesday; will paste customer replies here. Also noting: if shim work extends beyond 5 business days we need to revisit SOW and pricing. :calendar:
